title: Colorado land manager (surface management agency), simplified
attribution: Bureau of Land Management, Surface Management Agency (SMA)

sources.name: blm_sma
sources.attribution: Bureau of Land Management, Surface Management Agency (SMA)

steps: BLM SMA limited-scale layer queried for ADMIN_ST = CO, private and unknown excluded (no polygon means private or unknown), server-side generalisation at max_allowable_offset_deg.
ST_MakeValid repairs self-intersections introduced by generalisation (polygonal parts kept); coordinates rounded; one feature per managing agency.

limitations: Managing agency is not current access, legal parking, closure status or permission to cross. Private inholdings smaller than the generalisation tolerance are not visible; boundaries are approximate (about 30 m).
State land (ST) includes State Land Board trust land, much of which is closed to public recreation without a lease or permit.
SMA describes surface administrative jurisdiction, not ownership detail (per BLM).
